name: Banking (best-practice baseline)
note: Generated from Triodian Metamodel 2.8.0 (reference-data/baseline-profiles.json) by tools/build-baseline-packs.mjs; do not edit by hand. A best-practice baseline for deposit-takers and lenders that holds in any jurisdiction; it names no regulator, and the jurisdiction's own obligations come from the matter brief.

nouns.customerHarm: A customer is wrongly declined, delayed, charged or paid, or blocked from their money.

inputs.name: Board risk appetite statement, current version
inputs.usedIn: All decisions and the consistency checks

inputs.name: Operational risk incident thresholds and reporting definitions
Critical operations register, with the tolerance for each
Register of material service providers and outsourcing arrangements
AI governance framework, permitted-use policy and AI inventory
Delegations, and the authority each provider holds under its agreement
Responsibilities of senior managers, as mapped under the accountability rules that apply to it
Incident notification procedure and its timings

override.decisions.0.prompts.1: Would we accept a provider's AI making a decision about one of our {customers}, or a service they rely on, without a person reviewing it? If so, within what limit?
override.decisions.1.prompts.1: Does a single wrong decision about one of our {customers} count as harm, or only a pattern of them?
override.decisions.2.prompts.0: For a provider's AI that makes decisions about our {customers} or our services, is a signed quarterly statement enough, or do we expect to be told whenever a limit is crossed?
override.decisions.3.priorities.0.interim: One of: limit the AI's use; suspend it; replace it with another provider or a manual process; add a compensating control; or accept, with a named accountable person
override.decisions.4.prompts.0: If our documents do not show whether a provider uses AI to make decisions, how long are we prepared not to know?
override.decisions.5.prompts.1: If one AI provider failed or changed its terms, how many critical operations would be affected? That count is measure M10.
override.decisions.6.purpose: To define the events that must be reported to the {entity}, and how quickly, so that it can monitor the AI its providers use and meet its own incident notification obligations to {regulator}.
override.checks.4.fails: A ceiling is higher than the delegations or the AI policy currently allow for that function
